Package com.cab302.vic.model

Class HoursEntry

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.model.HoursEntry
public class HoursEntry extends Object
Hours a volunteer has logged against an event they attended.

Every entry starts as HoursEntry.Status.PENDING. The event's coordinator then approves or rejects it, optionally with a note explaining the decision. Only approved hours count towards a volunteer's total.

    • HoursEntry

      public HoursEntry(int id, int userId, int eventId, double hours, HoursEntry.Status status, String reviewNote, String loggedOn)
      Creates an hours entry.
      Parameters:
      id - the database id, or 0 if not yet saved
      userId - the volunteer who logged the hours
      eventId - the event the hours were worked at
      hours - the number of hours worked
      status - where the entry is in review
      reviewNote - the coordinator's note, or an empty string
      loggedOn - the date the hours were logged, as YYYY-MM-DD
